subject: Classic saved column layout audit and bounded raw projection design
independence: Audit/proposal authored by error_codec; this reviewer authored neither. This review assesses source/design only, not the mutable candidate header or any implementation.

supplemental_original_dependency.scope: Source-only clone dependency context; audit original28/60 inventory is unchanged.

checks.scope: Actual classic identities and exact/default lookup
checks.evidence: TableManager constants map incomplete MyTorrents and complete MySeeders; split view passes these through optional scoped IDs. TableColumnManager casts Table.<id> first and only a null/absent map consults cloned TableDefault.<base>; an existing empty map wins. Base strips after the last ::. Wrong exact/default map type is not valid absence and must not silently fall through. .big/.small/tag/group maps remain independent and raw; projection chooses only the two declared classic IDs.

checks.scope: Executable slot format and integer narrowing
checks.evidence: Complete loadSettings and saveSettings agree visibility0, position1, width2, autoTooltip3, direction4, userData5, alignment6, foreground7, background8, icon9; the nearby width/position comment is stale. Ordinary bencode Integer maps to Java Long Number.intValue signed low32. Raw signed64 and interpreted signed32 must remain separately owned facts; source Java-only Number subclasses are outside ordinary decoded bencode equality. Visibility/autoTooltip are exactly low32==1; icon is low32!=0. Conversion must avoid implementation-defined or overflowing C++ narrowing.

checks.scope: Requested facts are not effective runtime layout
checks.evidence: setVisible can move an initially invisible column; legacy position fallback can show/hide it; ensureIntegrity hides -1, reindexes other registered columns and can reset/save when none remain. Width applies registered min/max and existing/default widths, so a raw negative/zero/extreme requested width is a fact rather than a portable effective width. A pure snapshot must retain missing, wrong-type and malformed distinctions without inventing effective visibility/width/position. Native visual bounds16..8192 and unique-order compaction are future GUI admission policy, not source defaults or this projector.

MapUtils.getMapList accepts any List including empty; wrong top type returns null and permits legacy lookup. A present empty list remains a current list (painted table later supplies # default); invalid members become null via MapUtils.getString and do not justify legacy or later-known-ID promotion. SortColumn is considered only without a list and accepts String/byte[]; byte[] uses JVM default charset whereas SortColumns members use explicit UTF8. Preserve ordered IDs, invalid slots/duplicates, source provenance and raw bytes. Slot4 nonnegative low32 gives ascending iff1, otherwise descending; negative leaves current direction, missing/wrong invokes runtime default. Neither inherited case may become assumed ascending.

Without current list/legacy singleton, original getter consults global <table>.sortColumn and removes it plus .sortAsc; missing/wrong list position/width/tooltip may consult global Table.<table>.<column> keys. The audit accurately leaves that file unread and unresolved. The original condition s!=null || s.isEmpty() can fault for a null provider result; projection must neither repair nor execute this active behavior. Default arrays, force-visible flags, constructor sort settings, plugin registration and reset hooks can change applied state. The reset-version map has no active entries and RERESET=false, so no invented last.reset migration is warranted.

checks.scope: Malformed subvalues, raw preservation and ownership
checks.evidence: Wrong/non-list Column values behave as empty list in original loader, not valid known zeros. Each absent/wrong slot must preserve requested-fact provenance and legacy-needed flags; bad RGB may throw after earlier Java mutations, which pure independent facts do not reproduce. Keep complete unknown tables/columns/userData/tails/nonUTF8 bytes with one fresh immutable owned Document, not per-record duplicated subtrees. Reject supported edited-Document inputs before projecting raw facts. Frozen parser duplicate dictionary rejection remains explicit; repeated sort/list values are different and remain preservable.

4MiB input,100000 nodes/depth64, two selected tables,1024 column slots per selected table,32 sort slots,256 ID bytes and4096 issues are explicit native maxima with lower-only caller limits. Count actual malformed/unknown selected Column slots and sort entries before skipping, never silently truncate. Include key/dictionary nodes and whole unknown subtrees in supplied-Document validation. Check cumulative size/count arithmetic and all selected-field copies, fail whole projection on Limit/Memory rather than returning partial data. These limits are not an allocation-free/RSS promise; exact implementation/rollback and boundary tests remain required.

checks.scope: Projection-only checkpoint and preserved native UI
checks.evidence: Root selected pure core projection only. Proposed adapter, legacy config reads, Host dispatch, GUI mapping, widths, Reset policy, persistent writer/private IDs and profiles remain separate unimplemented gates. Current chooser reset is construction snapshot; Name Stretch, existing single UserRole sort, stable logical0..12/selection/Target/Close Tab behavior must remain unchanged here. Source column correspondence is layout-only and expressly excludes original size/done/down/# aliases to deliberately saved native columns.

All28 full original Git blobs,60 complete original definitions/bodies and18 native audit files/eight complete native definitions independently rechecked. Original audit historical head9e890 and its four WIP observations are preserved truthfully; the same observed bytes now equal actual03e31 implementation and0e96 metadata Git commits. All five prior context pins remain exact. Supplemental original BEncoder cloneMap/list/clone inspection confirms null preservation and deep cloning through TreeMap/list/byte-array helpers; no ordinary Java constructor or service was run.

implementation_constraints: Use a requested/raw-facts vocabulary; do not advertise table snapshots as original effective layout or resolved visibility/width/sort.
Exact wrong-type table/default must remain an explicit failure/fact; it cannot become absent and select a different layout.
Retain present empty SortColumns and invalid member slots as authoritative current data. No silent legacy or later-known-key promotion.
Legacy/global fallbacks and inherited sort defaults stay unresolved; no implicit biglybt.config read and no source migration/removal.
Keep raw source ownership independent from caller Document edits/lifetime; fail malformed/limit/edited input transactionally with no partial external publication.
Future adapter/UI/writer policies, private IDs, actual original default/plugin behavior and runtime equality require separate review/qualification.
nonblocking_limits: The audit includes future adapter/UI/writer proposals; root authorizes only pure projection for this checkpoint. No such later behavior is implemented or approved by this review.
No actual Java observations, native implementation/compilation/tests, effective layout application, original default/plugin registry or config migration parity credit.

Pure snapshot may characterize ordinary decoded bencode integers/bytes/lists/maps and retain malformed raw facts; it does not reproduce every Java object subclass, exception/partial-mutation or default-charset environment.
